questions.q: What lesson does the class draw from Dinah going out to see the daughters of the land?
choices: Keep watch over the daughters; give not overmuch liberty
Daughters should marry outside the family
Daughters should live in the city
questions.explain: The father waketh for the daughter (Ecclesiasticus 42:9-11).

questions.q: What did Hamor propose, the opposite of the law?
choices: Make marriages with us and become one people
questions.explain: Assimilation and intermarriage is the offer the nations always make, and the law forbids it.

questions.q: According to Judith 9:2-4, who gave Simeon the sword against Shechem?
choices: The Lord God, to take vengeance of the strangers who defiled the maid
questions.explain: They were moved with the zeal of the Most High.

questions.q: What did the brothers answer Jacob?
choices: We did it for the wealth
Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
questions.explain: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel (Deuteronomy 23:17).
